name: copilot-traces-hf
description: Save your GitHub Copilot chat sessions as agent traces and upload them to Hugging Face datasets or buckets, ready for the Hub trace viewer.

commands.title: Upload All Sessions of This Workspace

copilotTraces.target.markdownDescription: Where traces are uploaded: `datasets/<user>/<name>` or `buckets/<user>/<name>`. Created if missing.

copilotTraces.visibility.description: Visibility used when the dataset/bucket has to be created.

copilotTraces.pathInRepo.description: Folder inside the dataset/bucket where trace files are written.

copilotTraces.harness.markdownDescription: `harness` id written in each trace header (see the Session Traces Format docs).

copilotTraces.includeWorkspaceName.description: Include the workspace folder name in the trace header.

copilotTraces.maxToolResultChars.description: Truncate individual tool results longer than this (0 = never).

copilotTraces.redact.secrets.description: Replace common secrets (API keys, tokens, private keys, passwords) with placeholders.

copilotTraces.redact.homeDirectory.description: Replace your home directory with ~ and your OS username with <user>.

copilotTraces.redact.customPatterns.description: Extra regular expressions whose matches are replaced with [REDACTED].

copilotTraces.confirmBeforeUpload.description: Ask for confirmation before manual uploads.

copilotTraces.autoUpload.enabled.description: Periodically upload new or changed sessions to the configured target.

copilotTraces.autoUpload.scope.description: Auto-upload sessions of the current workspace only, or of all workspaces.

copilotTraces.additionalUserDataDirs.markdownDescription: Extra VS Code `User` data directories to scan (e.g. `~/.config/Code - Insiders/User`).

copilotTraces.hubUrl.description: Custom Hub endpoint (leave empty for https://huggingface.co).

scripts.package: npm run typecheck && npm run build && vsce package --no-dependencies --allow-missing-repository
scripts.test:integration: npm run build && npm run build:test && xvfb-run -a node test/integration/run.js
